svg.title: Multi-Region Disaster Recovery with Route 53 Failover
svg.desc: Warm standby architecture with primary us-east-1 and secondary eu-west-1. Uses AWS service icon artwork for Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, EC2 Auto Scaling, Aurora, S3, DynamoDB, AWS Backup, CloudWatch, EventBridge, and Lambda.
svg.text: Multi-Region Disaster Recovery with Route 53 Failover
Warm Standby • Primary: US East (us-east-1) • Secondary: Europe (eu-west-1)
Health checks • application FQDN • DNS TTL
Traffic switches to the secondary DNS answer when primary is unhealthy
Global database replication • promote secondary in runbook
Important: Route 53 DNS failover does not promote Aurora by itself. Confirm secondary database write readiness through the recovery runbook.
AWS service icon artwork • diagram draft
